scope: M1 tick-score parser admission, semantic parity, and resource bounds

reference.name: Symusic
reference.role: differential oracle only for supported, well-formed tick-score inputs

parser_modes.legacy_rust: parse_score_smf remains the trusted/unlimited Rust fast path
parser_modes.checked_rust: implemented: parse_score_smf_with_limits(data, ScoreParseLimits) returns ResourceLimitExceeded with ScoreResource
parser_modes.python_default: implemented: parse_score(data, limits=None, mode='compatible') and Score(data, ...) use finite ScoreParseLimits::DEFAULT; None never means unlimited
parser_modes.python_unlimited: implemented: parse_score_unlimited(data) is the explicit trusted/legacy escape hatch and is unsafe for hostile bytes
parser_modes.compatible: implemented: enforce finite limits, accept omitted EOT, and stop/ignore after first EOT
parser_modes.strict: implemented: enforce finite limits and reject missing/duplicate EOT, events after EOT, invalid running status after system events, invalid strict division, and file trailing bytes

semantics.contract: decoded deltas are exact score times and durations
0x0fffffff is admitted as one delta without sign or width loss
one- and two-data-byte status runs preserve program, controls, notes, and grouping order
both F0 and F7 clear running status; the following data byte is rejected as RunningStatusMissing
semantics.current_observation: current Miso scan, raw parse, and score parse reject at absolute byte 31; historical competitor behavior differs: Mido accepts F0 continuation differently and Symusic omits the F0 note

semantics.contract: FF meta events clear running status; the following data byte is rejected as RunningStatusMissing
semantics.current_observation: current Miso scan, raw parse, and score parse reject at absolute byte 32; historical Mido and Symusic behavior accepts and pairs the note

semantics.contract: output order is source track, channel, program; channel 9 is drum
same channel/pitch note-offs complete outstanding note-ons FIFO
retain closed zero-duration notes; discard orphan offs and dangling ons
retain CC and bend rows; matched CC64 creates one pedal interval
sort by tick stably, retaining source parsing order at equal tick
invalid UTF-8 sequences become one U+FFFD each; normalized bytes count toward text limits
coalesce lyric content with the current channel-zero/program group; Symusic 0.6 may split an otherwise identical group
tick score does not retain SysEx/unknown events; explicit channel status after F0/F7 remains valid; Symusic 0.6 misreads the F7 timing case
retain raw 16-bit division; no cross-library tick-score equality claim
all three SMF formats parse; strict rejects TPQ zero and invalid SMPTE frame/tick encodings while accepting valid SMPTE; compatible retains raw division
semantics.current_observation: Miso compatible retains TPQ zero and raw invalid SMPTE 0x8000; strict rejects them and accepts valid SMPTE. Symusic rejects all SMPTE.

semantics.contract: zero-length name/marker payloads consume no text-arena bytes and do not create a nonempty marker row
opt-in checksum-pinned One_track_MIDIs and Multitrack_MIDIs corpus; each file must equal its manifest contract and the installed Symusic 0.6 contract

strict mode rejects missing/duplicate EOT, events after EOT, and file trailing bytes; compatible mode accepts chunk-end without EOT and stops/ignores after first EOT while raw lossless mode preserves bytes separately
semantics.current_observation: Miso compatible accepts missing EOT and ignores post-EOT content; strict rejects both. parse_score_unlimited retains legacy post-EOT semantic events. Symusic accepts missing EOT and ignores post-EOT events; Mido iterates post-EOT events.

error_contract.rust: implemented: ParseError { offset, kind: ResourceLimitExceeded { resource: ScoreResource, limit } }; display uses 'score parse limit exceeded: <description> (limit <limit>)'
error_contract.python: implemented: parse_score and Score use finite defaults (or caller-provided ScoreParseLimits) and preserve Rust resource-limit ValueError text; parse_score_unlimited is explicit trusted-only legacy behavior
error_contract.precedence: input/header/chunk limits are checked before allocation; event, note, text, global, and overlap limits are checked before appending the triggering item; structural errors at an earlier byte win
